items.problem: DataTemplate using x:Bind/x:DataType failed to resolve (WMC0909 'Cannot resolve DataType local:Scenario' / WMC1111) during the namespace rename; agent switched to classic {Binding Title}.
items.evidence: build-events turn 36 'MainPage.xaml(33,30): XamlCompiler error WMC0909: Cannot resolve DataType local:Scenario'; fixed in one edit at turn 37.
items.covered_clearly_at: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md '### `x:Bind` and compiled bindings' (line ~576) — x:Bind is supported with the same syntax; type-resolution failures point at stale namespace prefixes in the XAML.
items.why_no_skill_change: x:Bind support is already documented, and resolving a DataTemplate binding (add x:DataType or fall back to {Binding}) is standard WinUI knowledge a capable model fixes in one turn — which is exactly what happened. The transient failure here was a side effect of the in-progress RootNamespace rename, not a skill gap.
